name: Knowledge source limits (list; uploaded files; public URLs)
symptom: Observe and record: a second SharePoint list, a 21st uploaded file, a URL deeper than two path levels, a URL with a query string, and a fifth public URL cannot be added (exact message undocumented)
cause: Agent Builder allows 1 SharePoint list, 20 embedded files, 100 SharePoint items and 4 public URLs (two path levels, no query strings); a list holds up to 20,000 items and 50 MB of text
fix: Add a library instead of many uploads; choose the one list that matters (Copilot Studio or a connector for more); use short URLs without query strings

name: Instruction character limit
symptom: Observe and record: pasting the 9,000-character instruction file is truncated or blocks Update
cause: Instructions are limited to 8,000 characters in Agent Builder
fix: Restore the 2,712-character instructions; keep facts in knowledge sources and behavior in instructions

name: Sharing scope (Can edit / Can chat; groups; org-wide)
symptom: A group cannot be given Can edit; org-wide toggle may be grayed out; chat users do not see the agent in My agents
cause: Agents are private by default; groups can only be chat users; org-wide sharing is an admin setting that applies to Agent Builder agents
fix: Add editors individually; add groups as Can chat; ask the admin to allow org-wide sharing; reshare after updating an agent with SharePoint file knowledge

name: Unlicensed users and shared agents
symptom: Observe and record: an unlicensed user cannot add the agent, gets an error, or gets no SharePoint or embedded-file grounding; cannot author agents
cause: Shared agents need the licenses their capabilities require; Copilot Chat without billing excludes SharePoint and embedded files; unlicensed users have no agent authoring
fix: Assign a Copilot license, or enable pay-as-you-go connected to SharePoint agents, or build an agent that uses only no-billing capabilities

name: Restricted SharePoint Search (discussion only)
symptom: Not reproduced (tenant-wide). Per docs: SharePoint knowledge sources cannot be used while Restricted SharePoint Search is on; uploaded files still work
cause: SharePoint knowledge is unavailable when Restricted SharePoint Search is on
fix: Fix oversharing at the source (permissions, labels) and turn Restricted SharePoint Search off

name: Conflicting leave policy versions
symptom: Observe and record: without a version rule the agent may answer from Leave Policy v3 (18 days at 6 years, 10 days carry-over) or mix versions, without flagging the conflict
cause: Both versions (same Document ID HR-POL-012) are in the HR-Policies library scope and v3 is not marked superseded; retrieval uses the most relevant files
fix: Fix A: instruction rule to use the latest effective date and mention the older value. Fix B: select HR-Policies files individually without v3. Also mark or archive superseded content

name: Whole-site vs specific-library scoping (Archive-Bulk)
symptom: Observe and record: with the whole Operations site as knowledge, the single memo IM-2025-0873 (pole P-44817, woodpecker damage) may be missed, confused with another memo, or uncited
cause: A site URL includes about 1,200 near-duplicate archive files; Copilot reads full content of up to 20 files and otherwise the 20 most relevant
fix: Scope knowledge to the Archive-Bulk/2025/09 folder (or the single file); keep archives out of day-to-day agents
